'''Murkhana City''' was the capital city of [[Murkhana/Legends|Murkhana]] and headquarters of the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]]. Magistrate [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]] had allowed crime to flourish in Murkhana City, as long as he was able to profit&mdash;and he certainly succeeded in doing so. The city was taken by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]&mdash;and soon-to-be [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]]&mdash;in the closing hours of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] during the [[Battle of Murkhana (Clone Wars)|Battle of Murkhana]].

Murkhana City was located on the black-sand shore of [[Murkhana Bay]], and many of its buildings, including [[Argente Tower/Legends|Argente Tower]], looked as it they were grown from coral. Murkhana City contained extensive communications arrays used to broadcast [[Shadowfeed/Legends|shadowfeeds]]. It had four ten-kilometer-long bridges that linked the city to [[Murkhana Landing]].
